goal: SOTA BPC for autoregressive char-level text generation on enwik8 (target <= 1.05 BPC) and text8 (target <= 1.05 BPC).

committed_budget.source: BUDGET RE-LOCK (2026-08-09, iter-20/v28). The 10M/384 commit (iter-19/v27) FAILED its target: 2.2631 BPC @ 40 epochs (874s fit) vs the 1.87799 target — the data cut to 10M chars + batch 384 slashed optimizer steps ~12x (3.7k vs 43.7k), leaving the model data/step-limited and non-convergent. Correcting back to the known-converging 30M chars / bs96 (43.7k steps @ 40ep, the budget that produced the 1.87799 new best) while KEEPING the v27 pipeline optimizations (vectorized sliding_window_view datasets, steps_per_execution 16, warmup 150, TimingCallback). The minimal-converging-budget search continues; this is the next probe. These are compute levers only: DO NOT inflate limit_chars/epochs/block_size to lower loss (compute inflation, rejected by push rule). Architecture hyperparams (chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, dropout, lr, weight_decay, ...) are NOT locked and MAY be tuned/swept. Steps/epoch auto-rescale to actual batch via steps_per_epoch_estimate().

current_best.time_to_convergence: ~58.7 min (3524s, est., old pipeline) to 1.87799 BPC @ E40 at 30M/512/40ep/bs96. iter-20 (v28) re-runs this budget on the optimized pipeline (vectorized ds, spe16, warmup150) to measure the time-to-convergence delta.
current_best.notes: Iter-15 (kernel v23) = window-warmup run. New best 1.8833 BPC. Iter-16 (v24, bigram-hash embedding rec 62) REGRESSED to 1.9049 BPC (hzyupupg, hopeful-tree-15, 3507s) — bigram disabled again in v25. Iter-17 (v25, chunk QK-norm rec 5) ERRORED at build time: QKNormAttention multiplied 4D logits [B*K,H,N,N] by 3D mask [B*K,N,N] (missing head-dim broadcast) — training never started (run kapdvdg0). Iter-18 (v26) fixes the mask broadcast (m->[B*K,1,N,N]) and re-runs the QK-norm architecture: NEW BEST 1.87799 BPC (gpnqp8gs, breezy-tree-17, 40/40 epochs) — the previous 1.8833 was never beaten until this run; baseline was NOT updated then (missing record). Iter-19 (v27) recommits the compute budget to 10M chars / block 512 / stride 256 / bs384 (+ warmup 150, steps_per_execution 16, vectorized datasets, timing logs) — the first run at the new committed budget. RESULT: 2.2631 BPC @ 40 epochs in 874s fit (w7to9wg0, hardy-aardvark-18) — NON-CONVERGENT vs the 1.87799 target (3.7k optimizer steps vs 43.7k; ~12x fewer). v27 pipeline itself is GREEN (QK-norm ok, timing logged, 40/40 epochs, no crash). Iter-20 (v28) restores the converging 30M/96 budget on the v27 pipeline to re-measure time-to-convergence. Progression: 3.493 -> 3.268 -> 3.011 -> 2.5909 -> 2.3023 -> 2.2878 (d1024/40ep, bs256) -> 2.2597 (bs512@10M) -> 1.8869 (30M chars, bs512) -> 1.8833 (window-warmup) -> [1.9049 bigram regression] -> [v25 QK-norm build ERROR] -> 1.87799 (v26 QK-norm fix, NEW BEST) -> [v27 budget probe regression 2.2631 @10M/384].

historical_source.note: Provenance kept for the agent's startup context. Identifiers (kernel slug, W&B entity/project/sweep/run) are NOT committed publicly — they are supplied to the runtime via GitHub Actions env vars / repository variables (WANDB_ENTITY, WANDB_PROJECT, WANDB_SWEEP_ID) and Kaggle secrets. Treat these fields as opaque labels when reading this file in the public mirror.

sota_reference.note: SOTA targets here are ballpark recent transformer-class results; the canonical target is improving on the user's own current best BPC, then chasing published SOTA.

next_iteration_directions: Iter-20 (v28, to push): restore the converging 30M/512/256/bs96 budget on the v27 pipeline (vectorized ds, spe16, warmup150, TimingCallback, QK-norm). Purpose: re-measure time-to-convergence to ~1.87799 BPC vs the ~58.7 min of the old pipeline at the same budget. If wall-clock drops at same-or-better BPC, the optimization set is validated and budget is re-locked at 30M/96.

Budget search continues: the 10M/384 commit FAILED to converge (2.2631 @ 40ep, ~12x fewer optimizer steps). The minimal converging budget is the 30M/96 (43.7k steps) that produced 1.87799; candidate intermediate budgets (e.g. 20M/96, 30M/128) can be probed only if they keep >=~40k optimizer steps — the step count, not wall-clock, is the binding constraint for BPC at fixed architecture.

Architecture tuning is OPEN (not locked): sweep/tune chunk_size, d_model, chunk_dec_layers, nhead, dim_ff, quantized_dim, compressor_emb_dim, token_dec_*, lr, weight_decay — these are NOT compute-inflation and are the real BPC levers. Do NOT touch committed_budget fields.
Re-enable the online W&B sweep over d_model/chunk_dec_layers/lr once v28 confirms the corrected budget converges at improved time-to-convergence.
Add ModelCheckpoint every epoch + resume-on-restart so a TPU session timeout never loses progress.
